dependenciesComments.@plone/mockup: Same version as the plone.staticresources release we build for (3.0.5 -> mockup 5.6.9), which shares the Svelte runtime via module federation.
dependenciesComments.svelte: Pinned exactly to the Svelte runtime of that plone.staticresources release (3.0.5 -> 5.56.10). The compiler must not be newer than the shared runtime: newer compilers emit runtime helpers (e.g. only_child in 5.57) that the host does not provide.
